name: pookie
description: Native SoundCloud client built with .NET and MewUI

scripts.build-linux: dotnet publish src/Pookie.App -c Release -r linux-x64 --self-contained true -o artifacts/linux-x64
scripts.build-win: dotnet publish src/Pookie.App -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o artifacts/win-x64
scripts.build-mac: dotnet publish src/Pookie.App -c Release -r osx-arm64 --self-contained true -o artifacts/osx-arm64
